meta.title: SquareWise logo exploration
meta.anchor: KenKen-style puzzle app with a calm, premium, dark-mode interface
meta.summary: Explore a logo system that feels geometric, modern, and puzzle-first without slipping into generic mobile-game branding.

preserve: Grid and cage-clue DNA from the puzzle board
Small-size readability for app icon and top bar use

routes.label: Grid Monogram
routes.rationale: Builds an abstract square system that hints at S and W through modular cells.
routes.watch_out: Can drift into abstract SaaS territory and lose the immediate puzzle read.

routes.label: Wordmark + Cage Clue
routes.rationale: Uses the game mechanic itself as a refined framing device around a clean wordmark.
routes.best_for: Primary brand, app bar, marketing pages, and share imagery.
routes.watch_out: Needs disciplined spacing so the clue corners stay intentional rather than decorative.

routes.label: App Icon First
routes.rationale: Turns uneven cage cells and arithmetic hints into a compact icon system.
routes.best_for: Favicon, app icon, social avatar, and compact UI placements.
routes.watch_out: Works best as part of a system rather than as the only main logo.

routes.label: Premium Frame Mark
routes.rationale: Pushes the brand toward a quieter negative-space emblem.
routes.watch_out: Feels less tied to the actual game board and cage logic.

selection.selected_system: Use the wordmark-cage-clue direction as the primary logo and pair it with the app-icon-first symbol for small-size surfaces.
selection.caveat: Typography, spacing, and color values are still exploratory raster concepts and should be rebuilt as vector artwork before production.
